name: Platinenwerk Lausitz GmbH

payment_behaviour.note: last 12m: 15 of 22 invoices paid >3 days late, max 10 days. We pay it late and getting later: avg 3.8 (2024) -> 4.5 (2025) -> 5.6 days (2026). Paying on time is cheap goodwill.

financial_health.signal: Private, credit 150 unchanged, equity 39.5%; solvent but has sold below full cost for four years.

notes: Every event carries the note 'accepted below full cost to keep the volume' (EV-2023-70550-350030 through EV-2026-70550-350030).

situation: Private PCBA maker (EUR 88 m), sole source for the smart-pump control board. It asks +8.0% from 2027-01-01 (EUR 34.35 -> 37.10). Our own should-cost is EUR 37.24, so today's price is ~7.8% BELOW cost and the ask only brings it to cost; history confirms it has accepted below-full-cost prices to keep our volume. Electronic components are up 13.5% yoy (loaded boards +40.8%); copper is irrelevant to a PCBA. Squeezing hard risks supplier health on a sole-source part.

pressures.evidence: Selling below full cost for years; price 34.35 vs should-cost 37.24.
10 QNs in 12 months, ppm 701 in 2026Q3, two QNs open.

likely_tradeables.give: pay on time / faster (e.g. 30 instead of 45)
likely_tradeables.why: we pay 5+ days late; cash relief is real value to a below-cost supplier
volume security is what it has traded price for

arguments_that_should_land.argument: A control board contains no relevant copper; only electronic components and labour drive its cost.
arguments_that_should_land.why: removes the copper half of the letter

arguments_that_should_land.argument: ppm was 701 in 2026Q3 with two QNs still open.

arguments_to_avoid.why: EUR 37.24 is above even the asked EUR 37.10
sole source; a stabilise case charges supplier-health loss

persona.relationship_notes: has repeatedly sacrificed margin to keep us; goodwill is real but finite

key_quotes.quote: we are forced to adjust our prices ... by **8.0 %**
accepted below full cost to keep the volume
